items.text: Footage shows Yemen’s National Army artillery units destroying 8 Ansar Allah military vehicles with anti-tank guided missiles (ATGMs) on the western Marib front.

Several Saudi-made SKYWASP one-way attack UAVs (OWA-UAVs) launched by the Yemeni National Army were spotted over Ansar Allah-controlled Sanaa earlier today.
At least two of the drones have been shot down.

On September 18, Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te personally observed a large-scale joint precision-munitions live-fire exercise at the Jiupeng military range.
The Republic of China Navy (ROCN), also known as the Taiwanese Navy, launched a ground-based Hsiung Feng III (HF-3) supersonic anti-ship missile, which struck the decommissioned Lan Yang (FFG-935), used as a target ship to simulate a People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) combat vessel.
The exercise also involved rocket launches from M142 HIMARS and surface-to-air missile launches from Tien Kung III (TK-3), also known as Sky Bow, an anti-ballistic missile (ABM) system.
The drills were intended to practice the joint use of precision weapons against simulated targets representing a PLA amphibious force during a potential operation against Taiwan.

Photo shows a destroyed S-400 SAM system launcher in the Bryansk region, approximately 90 km from the border with Ukraine.
The launcher is claimed to have been used to fire RM-48U ballistic missiles, which have been regularly used by the Russian Armed Forces to strike Kyiv in recent months.
According to Ukraine’s Main Intelligence Directorate (HUR), up to 17 S-400 SAM launchers have been modified for use against ground targets.

An Italian Air Force F-2000A (Eurofighter Typhoon) was damaged during an overnight Ansar Allah drone and/or missile attack on King Fahd Air Base in Taif, Saudi Arabia.
The F-2000A is part of Italy’s Task Force Air Arabia detachment, which deployed four F-2000A Eurofighters, one E-550A airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) aircraft, and four C-130J/KC-130J aircraft to assist Saudi Arabia with air defense duties.
The Ukrainian Air Force continues to operate individual S-300V1 anti-ballistic missile (ABM) system units.
